evaluations.rationale: No other backlog story imposes an incompatible permission, behavior, constraint, state, or rule with viewing a list of sponsors.
Viewing a list of user profiles does not conflict with any other story's permissions or rules in the backlog.
Emailing all trainers from the website is not made incompatible by any other story.
Providing a clear map of buildings and rooms does not conflict with other backlog items.
Allowing trainers to edit their training node is not contradicted by any other story's rules or permissions.
Limiting to one registration per day per authenticated user is not directly contradicted by any other story that permits multiple registrations per day.
An admin view to track registration status does not conflict with other stories' permissions or constraints.
Adding attendees to a training waitlist is consistent with other registration and waitlist related stories.
Requiring acceptance of cancellation terms via checkbox does not conflict with other cancellation or registration stories.
Tying a cancellation deadline into the workflow does not impose a rule incompatible with other stories.
Adding events to a personal schedule is not in conflict with any other story's constraints or permissions.
Viewing which trainings a trainee signed up for does not conflict with other stories.

An admin view showing trainee information and filters does not conflict with other stories' permissions or rules.
A dedicated class page with the listed information and SEO-friendly URL does not conflict with other backlog items.
Listing training options with details on a page does not impose rules that conflict with other stories.
